title: Jets' Demario Davis spends nearly $1 million a year staying in shape to play at age 37

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets' Demario Davis spends nearly $1 million a year staying in shape to play at age 37
sources.description: Jets linebacker Demario Davis is heading into his 15th NFL season, and he has missed only one game in his NFL career, an impressive run of durability that he attributes to the way he takes care of his body throughout the year.
